messages:
jess (Sales): FYI we just got a 38-page compliance packet from AcmePay — SOC2 + HIPAA + GDPR/data residency asks. They need answers by EOD Tue to close procurement. Can product weigh in on priority and scope?

alex (Support): thanks for flagging. attaching their questionnaire link: https://files.internal/acmepay-compliance-2026.pdf :paperclip: — there's a bunch on audit logs + retention windows.

jess (Sales): timeline: procurement says decision this week if we can confirm archival + encryption commitments. they are evaluating Dedicated vs Private.

maya (Product): quick q — is AcmePay an ARR/customer commit or POC? that affects prioritization.

jess (Sales): ARR ~ $350k/year if we commit to retention & audit exports. POC option is smaller.

maya (Product): ok high commercial priority then. needs product/eng/security alignment. suggested next steps: 1) list required answers we can give from existing policies 2) call out gaps that need engineering work 3) estimate effort and minimal launch criteria.

sam (Eng): skimmed the packet. main asks that look non-trivial:
- configurable audit-log retention beyond default 90 days (they want 7 years for some logs)
- per-customer log export (S3 export with SSE-KMS)
- ability to restrict log storage region (EU-only)
- proof of encryption at rest + bring-your-own-key (KMS/HSM) for exported archives
- retention-disposition controls for legal holds

sam (Eng): rough engineering notes:
- retention extension: storage config + lifecycle rules — low complexity but needs UI + billing delta.
- per-customer export: build export pipeline + access controls — medium effort (2-3 sprints).
- BYOK: depends on KMS provider integrations (AWS/GCP/Azure) + key rotation — medium-high.

maya (Product): thanks. security, can we answer parts now while engineering schedules work?

taylor (Security): we can confirm current SOC2 artifacts and existing encryption details. we cannot commit to BYOK or 7yr retention on hosted product without architecture changes. For EU-only storage, we support regional routing on Dedicated/Private today; hosted API would need a new partitioning effort.

alex (Support): tagging the specific questionnaire items that we can answer from docs: Section 3.1 (encryption), 4.2 (incident response), 6.4 (access controls). I'll paste short answers into the doc and mark red items.

compliance-bot: uploaded: /evidence/acmepay/initial-responses-1769991234.md

jess (Sales): acme asks for concrete launch criteria: "Can you guarantee exported logs will be stored encrypted with customer-managed keys and retained for 7 years?" We need a short answer for procurement.

maya (Product): proposed reply to procurement (draft):
"We can provide verified SOC2 artifacts and encrypted storage. For hosted customers, we currently offer 90-day audit log retention; we plan a configurable retention and per-customer export feature in Q2; BYOK and 7-year retention are available today on Redwood Private or Dedicated with a contractual SLA. For AcmePay's needs we recommend Dedicated or Private. If AcmePay needs hosted with BYOK, we'll need a prioritized engineering rollout (estimate 8-12 weeks)."

alex (Support): +1. that's clear and sets correct expectations.

sam (Eng): engineering estimate for hosted BYOK + 7yr retention: 8-12 weeks + 1-2 on-call post-launch. Dependencies: KMS integrations, export pipeline, storage lifecycle tagging, UI for retention, billing adjustments. Can break into epics.

maya (Product): action items:
- alex: mark questionnaire items answered + items requiring engineering in the doc (by EOD today).
- sam: draft epics & rough story points for retention/export/BYOK (by tomorrow).
- taylor: prepare SOC2 artifact packet + list of controls we can assert (by EOD).
- jess: share commitment language with procurement + ask if Dedicated/Private is on the table (ASAP).

jess (Sales): will confirm Dedicated/Private preference and push procurement timeline.

taylor (Security): will provide artifact list and note where contractual controls needed.

sam (Eng): I'll create a GH epic and link here when draft exists.

maya (Product): once GH epic exists, we'll convert to backlog ticket and assign priority level (P0/P1/P2) based on ARR and contract timeline. If AcmePay signs for Dedicated, scope reduces because regional storage + retention are already supported.

alex (Support): added initial answers and flagged red items: https://files.internal/acmepay/initial-responses-1769991234.md :white_check_mark:

jess (Sales): ❤️ thanks team. I'll update customer and ask procurement for written confirmation on Dedicated vs Hosted preference.

maya (Product): agreed—keeping this thread as the single source for triage. once GH epic is up, paste ticket id here.

sam (Eng): GH epic created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/4821 — draft scope + rough points.

maya (Product): assigning P1 for now pending confirmation. closing loop later today. :thumbsup:
